response.justification: Bogdan is an exceptionally skilled software engineer with 15+ years of experience, but he is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirements. Critical disqualifiers include: (1) no demonstrated expertise in security technologies (encryption, authentication systems, device security, tamper detection)—the primary focus of this position; (2) no evidence of Japanese language proficiency, which is an explicitly required qualification; (3) career trajectory over the past 5+ years focused on web and full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, React) rather than embedded systems, firmware, or networking; and (4) lack of experience with Linux kernel development, networking protocols, or embedded device control. While he has old C experience and embedded exposure, these are dated and his recent specialization is orthogonal to the role.
strengths: Exceptional software engineering fundamentals with 15+ years of industry experience and demonstrated excellence across multiple technology domains
Strong commitment to software craftsmanship, testing practices, CI/CD pipelines, and code quality standards
Proven ability to rapidly master new technologies and languages, showing high learning capacity and adaptability
concerns: No demonstrated expertise in security technologies (encryption, key exchange protocols, authentication systems, attack detection, device security) which is central to this role
Resume shows no Japanese language proficiency; role requires native-level fluency—this is a hard requirement
Recent career heavily focused on web/full-stack development; lacks embedded systems, firmware, networking stack, and low-level systems programming background needed for this position

key_factors.factor: No security domain expertise or background
Career specialization in web/full-stack, not embedded networking
